Priya - Head of Sales: Quick heads-up: were rolling Ratecard v4.0 live on May 15th. Key changes: consolidated Dedicated SKUs, new burst pricing slider, and a formal grandfathering window for quotes issued before go-live.
Ryan - Sales Ops: Thanks Priya. Can you confirm the cutoff timestamp for grandfathering (UTC)? Also, any guidance for quoting in CPQ after cutoff?
Priya - Head of Sales: Cutoff = 2026-05-14 23:59 UTC. Quotes issued (signed quote or PO) before that time honor v3.x pricing for up to 12 months. New quotes after cutoff must use v4 pricing. CPQ will be patched with v4 rates on the morning of May 15.
Marta - Deal Desk: Important: exceptions/discounts that depend on old SKUs need manual review. Please tag any outstanding quote with `#legacy-rate` in the Deal Desk queue. We'll batch-review.
Ben - Finance: Note that any effective discount that increases net cost > 35% vs list will require CFO approval even under grandfathering. Please include margin impact in the ticket.
Legal Bot: Reminder: v4 introduces updated termination and data residency clauses. For deals requiring special residency terms, loop legal early.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Does the consolidation change Dedicated sizing guidance? I need to update the POC templates if so.
Priya - Head of Sales: Good call Sam. The mapping doc (internal) shows how old SKUs map to new ones + recommended sizing tweaks. Link: https://intranet.redwood/ratecard/mappings/v4.
Ryan - Sales Ops: CPQ note: I will lock CPQ pricebooks so reps can't select retired SKUs after the cutoff. For in-flight CPQ quotes created before cutoff we will add a hidden flag to ensure grandfathering.
Marta - Deal Desk: Created ticket DD-8021 to manage grandfathering reviews. If you have an in-flight quote that needs special terms (commit offsets, extended credits, or legacy discounts), attach the quote PDF + margin calc to DD-8021 and tag me.
DealDesk Bot: DD-8021 created: "Ratecard v4 grandfathering and legacy-quote triage". SLA: 72h for standard requests, 48h for exec escalations.
Ben - Finance: We'll run a daily delta report for the first 2 weeks post-rollout. If realized margin drops below threshold, Finance may pause approvals for non-exec exceptions.
Marta - Deal Desk: Quick operational guidance: (1) If customer signed before cutoff and requests an upgrade feature only in v4, we still honor v3 price but may require a tech change order. (2) No retroactive credits for renewals signed after cutoff.
Priya - Head of Sales: Action items: Sales Ops to publish CPQ guidance and patch timing; Deal Desk to triage legacy quotes (DD-8021); Finance to publish approval thresholds; Legal to post redlines summary. I'll send a company-wide announcement after the mapping doc and CPQ patch are live.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare updated POC templates and post them in the shared Drive.
Ryan - Sales Ops: Will publish CPQ KB and send an ETA to the channel once locked (ETA: 2026-05-14 09:00 UTC).
Marta - Deal Desk: Tag me in DD-8021 for high-priority quotes. For routine legacy quotes, we'll batch decisions daily.
Priya - Head of Sales: Thanks team. Keep exceptions tight; we want a clean transition. :rocket:
